name: Nitidez de Borde Laplaciano
description: Analiza Laplacian edge response distribución para detectar suppressed high-frequency edge detail characteristic of generado por IA images.
mechanism: Aplica Laplacian kernel para detectar edges and mide the estadístico distribución of edge responses. AI images often show suppressed high-frequency responses due to implicit smoothing in generation process.
parameters: Kernel: 3×3 Laplacian, Metrics: mean, varianza, kurtosis of |response|, Umbral: adaptativo
source: Wang, Z. et al. (2004) — Image Quality Assessment, IEEE TIP; Marziliano, P. et al. (2002)
useCase: Detección de perfiles de nitidez de bordes no naturales en contenido de IA

references.title: Wang, Z. et al. (2004). Image Quality Assessment. IEEE TIP.

strengths:
• Cálculo rápido
• Captura la calidad de bordes objetivamente
• Basado en operadores bien conocidos
• Buena señal complementaria de bordes
limitations:
• Sensitive to compresión JPEG
• Cannot distinguish AI from post-processing
• Image resolución affects results
• Some AI models generate sharp edges
